$comment: Agent OS's CLI fleet mapped onto Orca's CONFIRMED agent schema (2026-09-20).
What was verified in the vendored tree (v1.4.203 @ 776e424e):
- The agent picker has NO JSON registry. The fleet is code:
id union      src/shared/tui-agent.ts (TuiAgent, 37 built-ins)
per-agent cfg src/shared/tui-agent-config.ts (TUI_AGENT_CONFIG: detectCmd,
launchCmd, promptInjectionMode, paste/trust knobs)
UI catalog    src/renderer/src/lib/agent-catalog.tsx (label, cmd, icon,
homepage; i18n keys auto.lib.agent.catalog.*)
display names src/shared/tui-agent-display-names.ts (ALL_TUI_AGENTS derives
from this map, not the union)
- Per-agent customization is settings, not data:
agentCmdOverrides.<id>   replaces the launch command (global-settings-types.ts:375)
agentDefaultArgs.<id>    appended args (global-settings-types.ts:385)
agentDefaultEnv.<id>     launch env (global-settings-types.ts:387)
- The plugin path (orca-plugin.json contributes.agents: [{path}]) is
DECLARED BUT UNUSED at this pin: the manifest schema accepts it
(plugin-manifest.ts) and install validates the file's presence/size
(plugin-artifact-validation.ts), but no runtime code loads contributed
agent profiles. Do not build on it yet.
STATUS: mapping verified, wiring pending (Phase 3).
- ids marked "builtin" need only SETTINGS (agentCmdOverrides) to pin the
binary Agent OS resolves in config.js — no code change.
- ids marked "needs-new-id" require minting a TuiAgent union member:
tui-agent.ts + TUI_AGENT_CONFIG + display names + catalog entry, then
`pnpm run sync:localization-catalog` for the i18n key. Deliberately NOT
done inside Orca's tree without a TOUCHPOINTS row.
Conventions: `orcaId` is the TuiAgent string. `agentOsProgram` is what Agent
OS resolves (config.js). `cmdOverride` is the exact value to put in
agentCmdOverrides.<orcaId> so both systems launch the same binary; "(bare)"
means no pin — Agent OS also uses PATH.

agents.label: Hermes (Agent OS chief agent)
agents.notes: Council seat; spawned by hermes_misc.js/hermes_kanban.js. Orca already knows hermes — only the binary pin is needed.

agents.label: Codex
agents.notes: Agent OS runs it via routes/agents/codex-adapter.js (NOT routes/codex.js, which is broken: imports runCodex from ./shared, which does not export it).

agents.label: Opencode
agents.notes: Also a council seat; vendored submodule MiMo-Code is separate from the CLI.

agents.label: Prime Agent
agents.notes: Persistent `prime-agent --mode rpc` subprocess in lib/prime-harness.js. Orca's argv injection matches the same CLI surface.

agents.label: Antigravity (agy)
agents.notes: Orca's detectCmd `agy` already matches Agent OS's binary. Experimental stub mode (ANTIGRAVITY_FORCE_STUB=1) stays an Agent OS-side concern.

agents.label: Claude Code (Agent OS human-in-the-loop tmux session)
agents.notes: Do NOT override the `claude` id — that would hijack every plain Claude tab. claude-rc is a distinct wrapper (routes/claude-rc.js, opt-in CLAUDE_RC_TOKEN). Needs its own TuiAgent id (see needs-new-id) or stays Agent-OS-only.

agents.label: Kimchi
agents.notes: The harness that actually executes live kanban tasks (POST /api/kanban/approve|build -> dispatchPlanTasksLoop).

agents.label: Mavis / MiniMax Code
agents.notes: Bridge to a local mavis daemon (:15321); MAVIS_BRIDGE_HOST/USER/SSH_PORT enable cross-host dispatch — surface those via agentDefaultEnv when the id exists.
